subject.title: [Feature]: Harden Control UI Lit lifecycle boundaries

question: Should the Control UI Lit lifecycle hardening land as one coordinated modernization slice, or be split into smaller PRs by lifecycle seam?
rationale: The source evidence supports the work, but the protected maintainer label and broad UI surface require maintainer intent on scope and sequencing before automation should implement it.

options.title: Split by lifecycle seam
options.body: Create separate PRs for shared host/i18n, lazy external-source subscriptions, router pending/not-found state, and chat post-render/persistence teardown.

options.title: Land one coordinated slice
options.body: Allow one larger Control UI refactor if the owner wants atomic lifecycle cleanup and the PR includes broad browser proof.

options.title: Narrow to proven bugs
options.body: Defer shared abstractions and only fix individually reproduced lifecycle races with targeted tests.

recommendation.title: Split by lifecycle seam
recommendation.body: Create separate PRs for shared host/i18n, lazy external-source subscriptions, router pending/not-found state, and chat post-render/persistence teardown.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` has recent merged ownership in the affected chat/session Control UI surfaces and is the best available product-scope routing candidate from the history checked.
